indicator_name: Registered unemployed as a share of the labour force, monthly
description: Доля зарегистрированных безработных в численности рабочей силы, помесячно
methodology: Taldau 702956, national only, 2015-02 onward with irregular missing months (2026-08: 3.6 %). The count is REGISTERED_UNEMPLOYED (annual); monthly counts by region are published only by the labour ministry on data.egov.kz (API key required). The survey-based UNEMPLOYMENT rate is a different concept (ILO).
